data.name: Barbell Bench Press
data.instructions: Lie on the bench, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width, lower it to your mid-chest, and press back up explosively.

data.name: Conventional Deadlift
data.instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hinge at the hips to grip the bar, keep your back flat, and drive through the floor to stand tall.

data.name: Barbell Back Squat
data.instructions: Rest the bar across your upper back, unrack, break at the hips and knees to squat deep, then drive back up to the starting position.

data.name: Overhead Shoulder Press
data.instructions: Hold the bar at collarbone height, brace your core, and press the weight straight overhead until your arms are fully locked out.

data.name: Pull-Up
data.instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, pull your chest up to the bar by driving your elbows down, and lower with control.

data.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
data.instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, pull the barbell towards your lower ribcage, squeeze your shoulder blades, and lower.

data.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
data.instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides, raise your arms out to the sides until parallel with the floor, and lower slowly.

data.name: Romanian Deadlift
data.instructions: Hold the bar at hip level, push your hips back while keeping legs slightly bent until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then return.

data.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
data.instructions: Set an incline bench to 30-45 degrees, press the dumbbells up over your chest, and lower them with a controlled stretch.

data.name: Barbell Bicep Curl
data.instructions: Hold the barbell with an underhand grip, keep your elbows pinned to your sides, curl the weight up to your shoulders, and lower.

data.name: Tricep Pushdown
data.instructions: Attach a straight bar or rope to a high pulley, keep your upper arms steady, and push the attachment down until your arms lock out.

data.name: Plank
data.instructions: Support your body weight on your forearms and toes, keep your body in a straight line, and engage your core tightly.
